title: Placement separation formula never applies the 0.25 rad minimum — shipped world has overlapping node pick-spheres (n25/n30 are 0.68 units apart vs 1.9 hitbox diameter)
evidence:
var sep := MAXF_SEPARATION_FLOOR * (1.0 - float(attempt) / 80.0) * MIN_NODE_SEPARATION_RAD
		if sep < MIN_NODE_SEPARATION_RAD * 0.25:
			sep = MIN_NODE_SEPARATION_RAD * 0.25
(and scripts/world_seed.gd:26: const MIN_NODE_SEPARATION_RAD := 0.25 # keeps node hitboxes (r 0.95) from overlapping; scripts/node_site.gd: sphere.radius = 0.95)
detail: The extra MAXF_SEPARATION_FLOOR factor makes sep == ~0.0625 rad for every attempt (0.5 units at R=8), never the intended 0.25. Verified by running WorldSeed.node_placements(20260904, ...): closest pair n25/n30 = 0.0848 rad = 0.678 units < 1.9 hitbox diameter; 50/50 sampled seeds overlap. Overlapping Area3D spheres mean a press on one building can return the neighbor as first hit, starting the draw from the wrong node — misfires the E1.3 disambiguation contract.
recommended_fix: Change the formula to sep := MIN_NODE_SEPARATION_RAD * (1.0 - float(attempt) / 80.0) floored at MAXF_SEPARATION_FLOOR * MIN_NODE_SEPARATION_RAD, and add a test asserting minimum pairwise placement distance >= hitbox diameter.

title: Placement last-resort loop never retries: fallback position is computed once and returned even when it violates separation
detail: fallback is assigned before the loop and never mutated inside it, so the '10 more tries' comment is false: all iterations test the identical position, and if the check fails the code still hits 'return fallback' with separation unhonored — a silently overlapping node placement whenever the 80-attempt loop exhausts.
recommended_fix: Mutate the candidate inside the loop (e.g. re-roll lat/lon per attempt) and either return a guaranteed-valid position or push_error/omit the node when no valid position exists.

title: Pinch zoom is specified (epic E1.2 'scroll/pinch', spec matrix 'Scroll/pinch') but no gesture branch exists — trackpad pinch silently does nothing
detail: Only wheel buttons and left-drag are classified. On macOS trackpads a pinch arrives as InputEventMagnifyGesture, which matches no branch, so the E1.2 'scroll/pinch zoom through the ladder' input is reachable and produces no zoom and no feedback.
recommended_fix: Add InputEventMagnifyGesture (and optionally InputEventPanGesture) handling in _unhandled_input that accumulates factor and emits zoom_requested per crossed stop threshold.

title: Headless test suite hangs forever instead of failing when the staged world regresses: unguarded sites[0]/sites[1] indexing after a soft check()
evidence:
var a: NodeSite = sites[0]
	var b: NodeSite = sites[1]
(and tests/test_no_sim.gd:74-75: var a: NodeSite = sites[2] / var b: NodeSite = sites[3]; check at line 32 only records: check(sites.size() == 33, ...))
detail: check() only counts the failure; execution continues into _commit_endpoints/_parallel_merge. If node staging breaks, the out-of-bounds get unwinds the runner's _run_once before quit() runs — verified empirically: the headless process loops until killed (exit 124 under timeout 15), turning any world-build regression into a CI hang rather than a nonzero exit.
recommended_fix: Guard with 'if sites.size() < 4: check(false, ...); return failures' before indexing, or have run_tests.gd wrap each run_all() call so a script error still reaches quit(1).

title: The 'no Sim autoload registered' check is vacuous — get_setting("autoload", {}) always returns the default, so the check can never fail
evidence:
var project_sim: Variant = ProjectSettings.get_setting("autoload", {})
	check(project_sim == null or (project_sim as Dictionary).is_empty() or not (project_sim as Dictionary).has("Sim"), "no Sim autoload registered")
detail: Autoloads are stored under 'autoload/<Name>' keys, not an 'autoload' key. Verified by running the project: get_setting("autoload", {}) returns an empty Dictionary regardless, so is_empty() is always true and the contract branch is unverified even if a Sim autoload were added.
recommended_fix: Enumerate ProjectSettings.get_property_list() for names beginning with 'autoload/' and assert none ends with '/Sim'.

title: Parallel-pipe merge count is uncapped — cable radius and elevation grow linearly without limit on repeated connects of the same pair
detail: Nothing caps entry.count; strands saturate at 9 but radius_scale (and thus cable radius, trestle size, and arc elevation) grows 0.45 per pipe forever. Repeatedly connecting one pair (no confirmation/cost in E1) yields an arbitrarily fat, arbitrarily high cable swallowing both buildings.
recommended_fix: Clamp count (or radius_scale) at a max bundle tier, e.g. radius_scale = minf(1.0 + 0.45 * (count - 1), MAX_BUNDLE_SCALE).

title: capture_runner ignores save/dir error codes — a failed capture still prints success and exits 0
detail: save_png returns an Error that is never checked, and the success line is printed unconditionally; the run ends with get_tree().quit(0). On an unwritable captures/ path the harness reports success and commits nothing, silently breaking the A4 capture contract.
recommended_fix: Check the save_png return value and the make_dir_recursive_absolute result; push_error and quit(1) on any non-OK code.
